# Population-weighted accessibility impact analysis for 6 main flood
# scenarios. Generates bivariate choropleth maps (Figures 3, 4) and
# summary statistics table (Table 2).

## Setup
```{r}
source(here::here("Code/utils/loading_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/utils/impact_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/utils/export_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/00_scenario_definitions.R"))

load_processed_data()
```

## 1. Population-Weighted Delta Travel Time Calculation
```{r}
# 1.1 Compute delta travel time stacks for 6 main scenarios.
# Note: To ensure absolute numerical parity with the Full (15-scenario) pipeline,
# we use the same loading and subtraction methodology: subtract baseline from
# the entire stack first, then subset to main scenarios.
delta_full_all  <- load_flood_scenarios(type = "all") - base_tt_all
delta_full_hosp <- load_flood_scenarios(type = "hosp") - base_tt_hosp

delta_all_main  <- delta_full_all[[scenarios_main$label]]
delta_hosp_main <- delta_full_hosp[[scenarios_main$label]]

# 1.2 Parish-level aggregation: Population-weighted mean per scenario.
# estimand: Parish-level population-weighted mean impact for spatial aggregation (Maps).
df_impact_all_main <- compute_parish_impact(delta_all_main, Worldpop_density, Adm_boundaries)
df_impact_hosp_main <- compute_parish_impact(delta_hosp_main, Worldpop_density, Adm_boundaries)

# Classify total parish population into three tiers for bivariate mapping.
df_impact_all_main <- df_impact_all_main %>%
  mutate(Population_bin = factor(cut(Population_Sum, breaks = c(0, 10000, 30000, Inf), 
                                     include.lowest = TRUE, labels = c("Low", "Medium", "High")),
                                 levels = c("High", "Medium", "Low")))

df_impact_hosp_main <- df_impact_hosp_main %>%
  mutate(Population_bin = factor(cut(Population_Sum, breaks = c(0, 10000, 30000, Inf), 
                                     include.lowest = TRUE, labels = c("Low", "Medium", "High")),
                                 levels = c("High", "Medium", "Low")))
```

# 2. Bivariate Figure 3 (All Facilities)
```{r}
# Generates a single bivariate panel for a given scenario
plot_bivariate_main <- function(df, sc_label, title_text) {
  df$Weighted_bin <- factor(cut(df[[paste0("Average_Weighted_Delta_TT_", sc_label)]],
                                breaks = c(0, 30, 60, Inf), include.lowest = TRUE,
                                labels = c("0-30", "30-60", "60+")),
                            levels = c("0-30", "30-60", "60+"))
  
  df_bi <- bi_class(df, x = "Weighted_bin", y = "Population_bin", dim = 3)
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = df_bi, aes(fill = bi_class), color = "white", size = 0.1) +
    bi_scale_fill(pal = "DkViolet", dim = 3) +
    labs(title = title_text) +
    bi_theme() + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
}

plots_all_main <- purrr::map(scenarios_main$label, ~plot_bivariate_main(df_impact_all_main, .x, scenarios_main$label_plot[scenarios_main$label == .x]))
stopifnot(length(plots_all_main) == 6)

legend_bi <- bi_legend(pal = "DkViolet", dim = 3, 
                       xlab = "Δ Travel Time (min)", 
                       ylab = "Population Sum", 
                       size = 8,
                       breaks = list(
                         bi_x = c("0-30", "30-60", "60+"),
                         bi_y = c(">30k", "10k-30k", "<10k")
                       ))

fig3_grid <- wrap_plots(plots_all_main, ncol = 2, nrow = 3)
fig3_final <- (fig3_grid | legend_bi) + plot_layout(widths = c(2.5, 1))

save_manuscript_pdf(fig3_final, "Fig3_absolute_6scenarios_all_facilities_main", subdir = "Main", width = 15, height = 25)
```

## 3. Bivariate Figure 4 (Hospitals)
```{r}
plots_hosp_main <- purrr::map(scenarios_main$label, ~plot_bivariate_main(df_impact_hosp_main, .x, scenarios_main$label_plot[scenarios_main$label == .x]))
stopifnot(length(plots_hosp_main) == 6)

fig4_grid <- wrap_plots(plots_hosp_main, ncol = 2, nrow = 3)
fig4_final <- (fig4_grid | legend_bi) + plot_layout(widths = c(2.5, 1))

save_manuscript_pdf(fig4_final, "Fig4_absolute_6scenarios_hospitals_main", subdir = "Main", width = 15, height = 25)
```

## 4. Table 2 Summary (Flextable)
```{r}
# Pixel-level extraction (population-weighted sample) for summary statistics.
# Uses pixel-level sampled summaries for manuscript-level impact estimates.
# To ensure absolute parity with Supp, we use identical sampling size (100k) 
# and stable seeds (fixed in impact_utils.R).
s_all_main <- sample_weighted_pixels_from_raster(delta_all_main, Worldpop_density, "All Facilities", 100000)
s_hosp_main <- sample_weighted_pixels_from_raster(delta_hosp_main, Worldpop_density, "Hospitals", 100000)

pixels_sampled_main <- bind_rows(s_all_main, s_hosp_main)

# Free intermediate raster memory
invisible(gc())

summary_all_main  <- summarise_impact_metrics(
  pixels_sampled_main %>% filter(FacilityType == "All Facilities"), 
  c("Intensity", "Duration", "scenario"))
summary_hosp_main <- summarise_impact_metrics(
  pixels_sampled_main %>% filter(FacilityType == "Hospitals"), 
  c("Intensity", "Duration", "scenario"))

table_data_main <- summary_all_main %>%
  left_join(summary_hosp_main, by = c("Intensity", "Duration", "scenario"), suffix = c("_All", "_Hosp")) %>%
  arrange(Duration, Intensity) %>%
  dplyr::select(Duration, Intensity, 
                Mean_All, Min_All, Q25_All, Median_All, Q75_All, Max_All,
                Mean_Hosp, Min_Hosp, Q25_Hosp, Median_Hosp, Q75_Hosp, Max_Hosp)

ft2 <- flextable(table_data_main) %>%
  add_header_row(values = c("", "", "All Facilities (min)", "Hospitals (min)"), colwidths = c(1, 1, 6, 6)) %>%
  set_header_labels(Duration = "Duration (hr)", Intensity = "Rainfall (mm)",
                    Mean_All = "Mean", Min_All = "Min", Q25_All = "Q25", Median_All = "Median", Q75_All = "Q75", Max_All = "Max",
                    Mean_Hosp = "Mean", Min_Hosp = "Min", Q25_Hosp = "Q25", Median_Hosp = "Median", Q75_Hosp = "Q75", Max_Hosp = "Max") %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>% autofit()

save_manuscript_table(ft2, "Table2_scenario_summary_main", subdir = "Main", "Travel Time Increase Summary (Main Scenarios)")
```

## 5. Verification (Parity Check)
```{r}
# If Full Scenario outputs exist in the environment, verify that they 
# exactly match the corresponding subset of this Main analysis.
if (exists("pixels_sampled") & exists("pixels_sampled_main")) {
  val_full <- pixels_sampled %>% 
    filter(scenario %in% scenarios_main$label) %>%
    summarise_impact_metrics(c("scenario")) %>%
    arrange(scenario)
  
  val_main <- pixels_sampled_main %>%
    summarise_impact_metrics(c("scenario")) %>%
    arrange(scenario)
  
  if (isTRUE(all.equal(val_full$Mean, val_main$Mean))) {
    message("PARITY CHECK PASSED: Main summary statistics match Full subset exactly.")
  } else {
    warning("PARITY CHECK FAILED: Discrepancy detected between Main and Full summary stats.")
  }
}
```
